name: Lukestria Family
source: A boy with nothing and no one steals a man’s wallet on the street but is caught by the woman accompanying him. Intrigued by the boy’s thieving skills, the woman offers him a job, taking him off the streets. The boy is known as Gentle Wolf, though he initially didn’t realize he had just joined the mafia. Will he be able to rise through the ranks and stay alive in this line of work, or will he end up dead or caught by the authorities? His discoveries and choices will determine his future as a member of the Lukestria Family.​
